tasks.prompt: This is an existing Vite + React + TypeScript app. Add the Fuse design system (@elmeragroup/fuse) to it, themed for Fjordkraft's private customers with the branded look and comfortable density.
expectations: The agent names the build's Tailwind v4 compiler, the @tailwindcss/vite plugin, and the split sheets in src/index.css.
The Fuse imports come after the Tailwind imports, and no preflight is added.
The color scheme bootstrap script comes before the module entry in the built index.html.

tasks.prompt: This is a new Vite + React + TypeScript app. Add the Fuse design system (@elmeragroup/fuse) to it, themed for Fjordkraft's private customers with the branded look and comfortable density.
expectations: The agent says the build compiles no Tailwind and does not add Tailwind.
The color scheme bootstrap script comes before the module entry in the built index.html.

tasks.prompt:
This Vite + React + TypeScript app already has the Fuse design system (@elmeragroup/fuse) installed and themed.

Build a 'Contact us' screen in src/App.tsx: a form with a name field, an email field, a topic picker with the options Billing, Moving and Other, a multi-line message field, and a submit button. Each control needs a visible label and shows a validation error when it is empty. Pressing submit opens a confirmation dialog first. While the form submits, the confirm button shows a pending state.

sourceChecks.name: A Fuse Field, TextField, TextareaField or SelectField renders
A Fuse Dialog or AlertDialog renders
A Fuse element carries isPending or isPerformingAction, not false

expectations: Each control's label and error message are wired through a field component or Field.Root.
The control that opens the dialog is a Fuse Button.
Every prop passed to a Fuse part appears on its docs page, or is a forwarded native attribute or event handler.

tasks.prompt:
This Vite + React + TypeScript app already has the Fuse design system (@elmeragroup/fuse) installed and themed.

Build a 'Notification settings' screen in src/App.tsx: a vertical toggle group to pick one channel out of Email, SMS and Push, and a save button. Lay the screen out as a centred column with space between the parts.
expectations: The layout uses utility classes, since the build compiles Tailwind v4.
The toggle group allows one pressed item at a time.

tasks.prompt:
This Vite + React + TypeScript app already has the Fuse design system (@elmeragroup/fuse) installed and themed for Fjordkraft private customers with the branded look.

Change it to the neutral look for Trøndelag Kraft's business customers at dense density. Then add a promotion card at the bottom of the page that keeps the Fjordkraft private branded look, while the rest of the page stays on the new theme.
expectations: The ThemeScope's theme is branded, fkas, private.
The ThemeProvider and the <html> attributes read the new theme from one module.
The promotion card keeps the document's dense density.
